name: Turret Power
description: Each deployed turret feeds you power. +1 Magic Power per stack, up to 8. Lasts 30 turns if not refreshed.

name: Overclock
description: Over-driven firing rhythm. You attack quicker by 0.02 turn and deal +2% damage per stack, up to 5. Lasts 8 turns.

name: Shock
description: Residual charge slows movement by 0.025 turn and reduces willpower by 1 per stack, up to 10. At max stacks it triggers Overload (electrical damage and stun in a small area). Lasts 5 turns if not refreshed.

name: Ballistic Infusion: Arcane
description: Your bow is enchanted with arcane energy: your electricity hits put a Arcane Charge on the target.

name: Arcane Charge
description: Charge from arcane hits. It fades after 2 turns. At 3 stacks it releases Arc Spark.

name: Ballistic Infusion: Frost
description: Your bow is enchanted with frost energy: your frost hits put a Frost Charge on the target.

name: Frost Charge
description: Charge from frost hits. It fades after 2 turns. At 3 stacks it releases Shatterfrost Needle and slows the target.

name: Ballistic Infusion: Astral
description: Your bow is enchanted with astral energy: your holy hits put a Astral Charge on the target.

name: Astral Charge
description: Charge from astral hits. It fades after 2 turns. At 3 stacks it releases Astral Wisp.

name: Ballistic Infusion: Void
description: Your bow is enchanted with void energy: your death hits put a Void Charge on the target.

name: Void Charge
description: Charge from void hits. It fades after 2 turns. At 3 stacks it releases Void Pulse and saps the target's willpower.
